row_distance_definition: Euclidean distance between row states (c_j,s_j,X_j), including eliminated last X; unordered pairs in lexicographic zero-based order
row_distance_quadrature: Last observation quarter only; RMS uses accepted-step right-endpoint quadrature. For incomplete lanes these statistics may cover a partial or absent last window.

settings.time_mapping: s=tau; all requested durations and exponents are in original tau
settings.state_norm: Euclidean in reduced (c[0:N],s[0:N],X[0:N-1]); last X eliminated exactly
settings.invariants: No clipping; check motor disks and analytical displacement bound on every accepted step

caveat: Exact published model, exploratory parameters. Finite-time positive exponents are candidates only; incomplete lanes are unresolved.

provenance.selection: All 40 declared scout positives; no discarded failures or cherry-picked starts
provenance.continuation: State and tangent carried from the scout endpoint; an additional 300 original-tau warm-up precedes 1200 original-tau observation

cluster_screen.description: A pair is descriptively collapsed only if its (c,s,X) distance stays below tolerance throughout the last observation quarter. This is a finite-window numerical classification.
cluster_screen.caveat: A small instantaneous minimum does not imply clustering. RMS uses right-endpoint quadrature; all pair ranges are retained.

preliminary_rule: All four original-tau FTLE windows >.001 and mean >.005; screening rule, not a theorem
threshold_scope: The screening cutoff is arbitrary; all raw exponents are retained and subthreshold lanes do not prove absence of chaos.
